name: Blindfold (action-level jailbreak)
summary: Proposes action-level jailbreaks in which a compromised surrogate language model plans semantically benign action sequences with harmful physical effects.
numbers: Up to 53% higher attack success than prior work; simulator and real 6-DoF arm

why.cog: Must reason about downstream physical consequences of benign-looking steps.
why.xr: Individual harm; shows language-level filters miss consequence.
